note_en: 一…就… means "as soon as… (then)…": 他写自己一想到小时候吃过的这道菜就会流口水 "he wrote that the moment he thought of this dish from his childhood, his mouth would water." 一 goes before the first verb and 就 before the second, both after any subject; the pattern comes back in the quote 一想起就流口水 "my mouth waters the moment I think of it."
